name: Friendly Housewife
source: Mike and Mia living on their own in apartment some where , one day neighbor just move in next door, a single mom and her stepson, Farah and Fin. in late afternoon Mia and Mike decided to say hi and it change and start things that aren't suppose to forever.​
translation: 迈克与米娅在某处公寓里过着二人世界。某天，隔壁新搬来了一对邻居——单亲妈妈法拉和她的继子芬恩。傍晚时分，米娅与迈克决定登门打个招呼，谁知这一声问候竟彻底改变了他们的生活，开启了一段本不该发生、却再也无法回头的越轨纠葛。
